subject: Entitlements & network adhesion plan — SSO/SCIM/IP/service-account alignment
messages:
From: Alex Lopez <alex.lopez@finovate.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@finovate.com>; security@finovate.com
Date: Sun, 1 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Entitlements & network alignment for production cutover

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the engineering team was encouraged by Redwood's routing and prefix cache options. We're next on a tight timeline for our production activation (targeting 2028-08-15) and need to align the identity/network pieces so the CS <> Eng handoff is clean.

Specifically we want a short plan that covers:
- SSO/SAML assertion mapping (IdP attributes we expect)
- SCIM provisioning attributes + group sync cadence
- IP allowlist process for staging and prod ranges (our infra team needs a CSV template)
- Service accounts for server-to-server calls and acceptable key rotation cadence
- Org policies / minimum role mappings we should create in our IAM

Can Redwood share a compact checklist or playbook (1–2 pages) and the templates for IP allowlists and a service-account matrix? Also looping Priya (security) for any audit concerns.

We can do a 30-minute alignment this week. Open slots: Tue 10–11am PDT, Wed 2–4pm PDT.

Best,
Alex
Alex Lopez
Head of Platform Engineering | Finovate Systems

From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
To: Alex Lopez <alex.lopez@finovate.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai; monica_patel@redwood.ai; jordan_blake@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 2 Jul 2028 08:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Entitlements & network alignment for production cutover

Alex — thanks for the clear checklist. Attaching a short playbook and three templates (IP CSV, service-account matrix, SCIM example) to get you started.

Proposed plan (high level):
1) Today–Wed: intake and asset exchange (you complete the IP CSV + provide IdP metadata and the list of groups to sync).
2) Thu–Fri: Redwood config draft (we'll provision test service accounts and a staging role mapping inside your dedicated tenant).
3) Next Tue (2028-07-11): dry-run cutover in staging (validate SAML assertions + SCIM sync + IP exceptions).
4) 2028-07-25: freeze changes and schedule production cutover window (target 2028-08-15).

Immediate asks from your side:
- IP ranges for staging and prod in the attached IP template (ip-allowlist-template.csv)
- IdP SAML metadata (SAML XML) and the attribute map you use for email/displayName groups
- Any org policy constraints (e.g., MFA enforcement windows, role naming conventions)

I've put Ben on the thread to lead the service-account matrix (he'll own rotation guidance and naming), Monica will lead SCIM payload mapping, and Jordan will be the on-call Eng liaison for the staging dry-run.

Meeting: Wed 2028-07-04 14:00 PDT works for us — sending a calendar invite. Agenda: 1) intake checklist review (10m) 2) owners & milestones (10m) 3) risk/rollback guardrails (10m).

Attachments: ip-allowlist-template.csv; service-account-matrix.xlsx; scim-schema-example.json.

Thanks — looking forward to the sync.

—
Kimberly Park
Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference

From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai; Alex Lopez <alex.lopez@finovate.com>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.ai; jordan_blake@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 3 Jul 2028 09:33:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Entitlements & network alignment for production cutover

Alex / team — quick note from the implementation side:
- I'll own the service-account matrix and attach a filled example post-call (service-account-matrix.xlsx).
- Rotation recommendation: short-lived certs via our recommended KMS flow; fallback is 90-day key rotation with automated alerts.
- For the staging dry-run we need: at least one service account per environment (staging/prod), one team contact for emergency rotation, and a single pinned role mapping for read-only vs invoke roles.

Jordan — can you confirm availability for the dry-run on Tue 2028-07-11? We want console access to run an end-to-end token exchange and validate the KV/prefix caching under a 50rps load.

Also flagged risk: if Finovate's IP ranges are behind NAT or the CIDR changes frequently, we'll need an application-level fallback (token-based allowlist) we can enable for the cutover window. Please confirm.

— Ben
Ben Carter
Principal Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
Attachment: service-account-matrix.xlsx (stub)

From: Alex Lopez <alex.lopez@finovate.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai; ben_carter@redwood.ai
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@finovate.com>; jordan_blake@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 3 Jul 2028 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Entitlements & network alignment for production cutover

Thanks all — confirm Wed 7/4 14:00 PDT and I've uploaded our audit guidance (finovate-audit-requirements.pdf) to the shared Drive link in the invite. Priya will step through audit items during the call.

Quick answers:
- Our infra will provide two stable CIDR blocks for staging/prod — I'll fill the IP CSV today and drop it into the shared Drive.
- IdP metadata: sending SAML XML to your secure upload (DocuSign/Drive link in calendar invite).
- We can accept short-lived cert rotation but need a fallback 90-day cadence for cross-team alignment.

One ask for the meeting: please bring the staged role-mapping example we discussed (email-to-role mapping) so we can confirm naming conventions inline.

Alex
Alex Lopez
Head of Platform Engineering | Finovate Systems
Attachment: finovate-audit-requirements.pdf (stub)
